svg.title: Air-prepared BaTiO3 — three morphology categories
svg.desc: Original qualitative category icon, not traced from source pixels. Arbitrary SVG positions, contours and sizes; no scale calibration, atom positions, crystal facets, size distribution or specimen reconstruction. Air-prepared population only. Source reports 36 percent regular cubes, approximately 58 percent cube-like particles and approximately 6 percent truncated cubes. 20 nm mean edge belongs only to the regular-cube subset. Icon numbers and areas do not represent population fractions.

g.text: Three reported categories in one population; one icon per category
20 nm mean edge: regular-cube subset only, not the whole air population.
Icon areas and dimensions do not encode these fractions or measured aspect ratios.
Original category symbols; no measured contours, size distribution or packing.
Cube morphology does not identify a unique atomic crystal phase.
Adireddy et al. (2010) · Factual context remains in the source figures and record.
